notes.title: Steam Deck Support and Japanese Localization
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been a long time! I just added a very small update. It is more for players that have Steam Deck and for Japanese players.

- Add Japanese localization.
- Add Steam Deck support.

If you did not have leave a review already, please consider to do so. It helps me a lot :)
Also if you like fast paced action shooter platformer game, consider add my next game to your wishlist, it will help a lot as well: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190920/Corebreaker/]Corebreaker[/url]

Cheers,

Marcel

notes.title: Galaxy Champions TV - Golden Update
notes.notes:
Hello Champions!

I would like to announce that Galaxy Champions TV "Golden Update" is available now!
Follows the list of new features, changes and fixes:

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]40+ new upgrades.
[*]Score system is back!
[*]Global leaderboard: compete against other players from other platforms.
[*]Collection: collect all enemies and upgrades.
[*]New achievements.
[*]Difficulty levels: select difficulty before starting a run.
[*]Continue system: you have a limited amount of continues to beat the game.
[*]Loop: in Champions mode you can loop the game.
[*]Support more gamepad models.
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Replaced the skill tree with 60+ upgrades to create more replayability.
[*]Replaced the revive system with shared continues in co-op mode.
[*]Reduced amount of arena in each world, it makes the progress more solid and direct.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed gamepad detection issue.
[*]Fixed Vysnc and high frame rate issue.
[*]Fixed Steam Cloud sync issue with Linux and Mac.
[/list]

It took longer than we expected but the update is finally here! Hope you enjoy it! :)

Thank you very much everyone for the feedback, support and patience which made it possible for Galaxy Champions TV to get this far!

We are releasing the update with a special discount: [i]"I'd buy that for a dollar!"[/i] (almost) :D

Have a great week!

Best regards,

aQuadiun Team

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Species of Eight
notes.notes:
It’s another transitional time, view-chums, when the students are settling, the returning TV dramas are nervously eyeing up various sharks, and I must decide which of my first ever batch of plants must be sacrificed to the ice gods. Will it be Younas, the defiant mortar tomato? Surely it couldn’t be Wilfred, producer of the Great Unexpected October Chilli? Oh, the terrible burden of choice!

Fortunately, the demands of the column have prepared me, and in fact this time we’re having not five, not ten, but eight of the best overlooked games on Steam. Nobody tells Unknown Pleasures what to do. Except Graham. And Alice. And sometimes Brendy. And the magistrate that one time.

Making a noble sacrifice this week: Genetic meddling, smooth transitions, and Wooian manshoots. (more…)
